floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The 2 BR Type B suite values run opposite to the printed total order. The selector uses the published total columns. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 8 Nshama design renders and 2 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. A kitchen image appears in the Symphony update and was omitted. The fitness-room render also appears on the Symphony page and was left out here.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 3 and 7. Continental Club (https://continentalclub.ae/project/aria-at-town-square-park-town-square/) and JRE (https://jre.ae/projects/aria-on-the-park) publish different points, with the JRE point close to Berkshire Park. Nshama’s plot drawing is shown with project-name directions. The travel panel lists Dubai Marina instead of Dubai Hills Mall.
review.floorPlans: 10 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The 2 BR Type B suite values run opposite to the printed total order. The selector uses the published total columns.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
